_note: Events. trigger: {date} fires once on that date; {monthly_chance, conditions} rolls each month; {special: doomsday} fires on 29 February for nations with land or armies in Skyfall; {special: fired_by_effect} only through another event. for: a nation tag, 'all', 'player', 'tribes' (tribes and hordes), 'republics', 'monarchies', 'pig_states' (pig nations other than Menslosia) or 'others' (everyone but Menslosia and Skyfall). Effects target THIS (the nation receiving the event) or a tag. See README for the full list of condition and effect types. once: true fires at most once per nation. Trigger years: [from, to] (0 = open) limits an event to those years. Trigger mtth_months gives an EU4 mean time to happen; mtth_modifiers [{factor, conditions}] multiply it when their conditions hold (0.5 = twice as likely). fire_event effects (with delay_days) chain events.

events.title: The Arcadian Era Begins
events.text: The ash has cleared and the Incendium is over. Menslosia and Skyfall have sworn friendship. The world is ours to rebuild.

options.text: Rebuild with green power, never fossil fuels.

events.title: The Black Moon Rises over Our Troops
events.text: It is the 29th of February. The moon has turned black over Skyfall and the Doomsday Barrier has fallen. Our soldiers in Skyfall are caught in it as anomalies pour from the portal. Tomorrow time will reverse, but what we choose today will be remembered.

options.text: Join the Barrier Pact: fight beside Skyfall.
Exploit the chaos: study the anomalies in Midrea's labs.
Pull our soldiers back and wait for the dawn.

events.title: The Black Moon Rises
events.text: The Black Moon has torn the barrier open. Our king holds the line at Portal Isle while Demons and Angels clash above the clouds. Tomorrow time will reverse, but courage and cowardice will both be remembered.

options.text: Hold the Barrier alone, by the Will of Eden.
Call on Menslosia for the Barrier Pact.
Cast holy spells on everything that moves.

events.title: The Black Moon Rises
events.text: Our warriors in the sky islands watch the moon turn black. Things are coming out of the portal.

events.title: The Photographer
events.text: One of our explorers, a pig with a camera, was caught photographing Skyfall. Cameras are forbidden there. Skyfall has jailed him and refuses to release him.

options.text: Demand his return. He is a pig of Menslosia!
Apologise and pay for his release.

events.title: Execution in the Sky
events.text: Skyfall has publicly executed our photographer. The whole of Menslosia is in uproar. This is a question of who will be the great power of Arcadia.

options.text: Declare the Great War for Arcadia.

events.title: Scraps and Blueprints
events.text: King Bonaparte has found blueprints left by King Eden, written in a human language he calls German. He says they describe 'artillery' and 'tanks', lost machines of the human era.

options.text: Too much power for anyone. Lock them away.

events.title: The Staircase to Nowhere
events.text: A curious citizen has gone down a staircase that leads nowhere. They have not come back up. It is said the stairs only go one way: down, into the Backrooms.

events.title: Masks for the Mainland
events.text: Skyfallins cannot breathe the air of the mainland for more than a day or two. Our alchemists have designed an expensive mask that might let settlers and soldiers survive below.

events.title: An Heir is Born
events.text: The court rejoices: the realm has an heir.

events.title: A New Ruler
events.text: The old ruler is dead. Long live the new ruler! The court looks to them for direction.

events.title: A Regency Council
events.text: Our ruler has died with no heir old enough to rule. A council of nobles governs until an heir can be found and comes of age.

events.title: Rebellion!
events.text: Rebels have taken up arms in one of our provinces. If they hold it for half a year they will force their demands on us. Send an army to crush them.

events.title: Bountiful Harvest
events.text: The farms have outdone themselves this year. There is more grain than anyone can eat.

events.title: Truffle Rush
events.text: A pig in Sylvania has rooted up a truffle the size of a cabbage. Every pig in the empire wants to go digging.

events.title: The Core Surges
events.text: The Core flares with power. The islands rise a little higher, and every workshop in Skyfall hums.

options.text: Store it for the Black Moon.

events.title: The Young Boars Grow Restless
events.text: The young warriors of the tribe want to prove themselves.

events.title: A Great Scholar
events.text: A brilliant mind has appeared at court, full of new ideas.

options.text: Put them in charge of the treasury.
Send them abroad as an envoy.
Have them draw up war plans.

events.title: Weariness of War
events.text: The people are tired of war. Mothers want their sons home.

events.title: A Feast at Eden's Crown
events.text: King Napoleon invites the Pig Lord to a feast above the clouds to celebrate the friendship of our two nations.

events.title: Entities Through the Portal
events.text: The Black Moon did more than crack the barrier. Things from beyond have come through the Doomsday Portal, and time reversing has not sent them back. They will take what they can reach.

events.title: A New Term
events.text: The votes are counted and the republic has its leader for the next term.

events.title: The Provinces Want a Say
events.text: Far from the capital, local lords and councils run things their own way. They want the crown to admit it.

events.title: Loyal Governors
events.text: A generation of governors trained in the capital is taking up posts in the provinces.

events.title: A Rich Vein
events.text: Our miners have struck a rich vein of sanctum ore.

events.title: Mine Collapse
events.text: A shaft has collapsed with the night shift inside.

events.title: Scandal at Court
events.text: One of our advisors has been caught taking bribes from foreign merchants.

events.title: A Brilliant Mind
events.text: A young member of our council has impressed everyone.

events.title: Whispers Against the Throne
events.text: Pamphlets in the capital question whether our ruler is fit to rule.

options.text: Win them over with a festival.

events.title: The Fort Engineer
events.text: An engineer offers to modernise our walls.

events.title: The Veterans Return
events.text: Soldiers home from the wars bring stories, scars and skills.

events.title: Rats in the Granaries
events.text: A plague of rats has eaten through our winter stores.

events.title: A Comet in the Sky
events.text: A bright comet hangs over Arcadia for weeks. The priests argue about what it means.

events.title: Scholars Ahead of Their Time
events.text: Our academies have outpaced the rest of Arcadia. Foreign students are arriving in droves.

events.title: The Guilds Demand a Seat
events.text: The great trading houses want more say in the council.

events.title: Term Limits
events.text: Some in the council want our leader to rule for life.

events.title: The Great Hunt
events.text: The clans gather for the great hunt of the season.

events.title: Clan Feud
events.text: Two clans of the horde are at each other's throats over grazing land.

events.title: Settling Down
events.text: Some of our people want to stop wandering and build towns.

events.title: The Shaman's Vision
events.text: Our shaman has seen the black moon in a dream and warns us of what comes through the portal.

events.title: An Envoy from the Pig Lord
events.text: The Holy Empire of Menslosia sends an envoy demanding we return to the Empire.

options.text: Send him back with a firm no.

events.title: Independence Day
events.text: Our people celebrate the day we broke from the Holy Empire during the Incendium.

events.title: The Pig Lord Speaks
events.text: The Pig Lord addresses the Empire from the balcony of Sty Royal. The breakaway states, he says, are still Menslosian.

events.title: Parade in Unity
events.text: The Unity Guard marches through the capital in its new uniforms.

events.title: Pilgrims to Lotus Vale
events.text: Thousands of pilgrims travel to the Lotus temples to give thanks for surviving the Incendium.

events.title: The Sylvanian Question
events.text: Sylvania broke away when the Incendium burned the old roads. The Imperial Council is split on what to do about it.

events.title: Green Engineers
events.text: Menslosian engineers have built windmills that power a whole town.

events.title: The Old Bureaucracy
events.text: The Imperial bureaucracy is slow, corrupt and hungry for paperwork.

events.title: The Skyfall Embassy
events.text: Skyfall has opened a grand embassy in Mentos.

options.text: Host a feast for the angels.

events.title: The Truffle Wars
events.text: Truffle barons in Truffle Downs are fighting each other over the best groves.

events.title: The Heir's Education
events.text: The heir to the Pig Throne needs tutors.

events.title: Pilgrims at the Holy Waterfall
events.text: Pilgrims from the mainland come to Equator Isle to touch the waters that fall from Eden.

options.text: The waters are sacred. Close the shore.

events.title: The Barrier Guard
events.text: The angels who guard the Doomsday Barrier ask for more soldiers.

events.title: Black Moon Preachers
events.text: Preachers of the Black Moon are spreading their faith in the markets of Eden.

options.text: Let them talk. No one listens.

events.title: The Wing Trials
events.text: Young angels compete in the great flying trials over Eden's Crown.

events.title: The Gardens of Eden
events.text: The gardens of Eden are in bloom again for the first time since the Incendium.

events.title: The Council of Angels
events.text: The elder angels argue about whether Skyfall should rule the islands directly or through local chiefs.

events.title: An Island Sinks
events.text: One of the smaller sky islands has started to sink towards the clouds.

options.text: Hold it up with our magic.

events.title: The Eclipse Rites
events.text: Under a dark sky the Order of the Black Moon holds its rites.

events.title: Converts from Eden
events.text: Some angels of Skyfall have joined our Order in secret.

events.title: Whispers from the Portal
events.text: Our priests hear voices from beyond the Doomsday Portal. They promise help.

events.title: The First Harvest After the Ash
events.text: For three years nothing grew under the grey sky. This spring the fields of Mentos are green again.

options.text: Give thanks at the Lotus temples.
Sell the surplus to the mainland.

events.title: The Canada Ruins
events.text: Scavengers in the Canada Ruins have found a sealed vault from the old human world. The Pig Lord's own family name comes from these ruins.

options.text: Open it in the Pig Lord's presence.
Seal it again. Some things should stay buried.

events.title: The Vault of the Old World
events.text: Inside: rusted machines, crumbling books, and a working seed bank.

options.text: The seeds go to the farms.

events.title: The Caldera Rumbles
events.text: The ground near the Yellowstone Caldera shakes again. The Incendium began here.

options.text: Pray to the Lotus. It is only the earth settling.

events.title: The Pigman Engineers' Guild
events.text: The pigman engineers who built Midrea's labs want a charter of their own.

options.text: They serve the Pig Lord, not a guild.

events.title: Fire at Sty Royal
events.text: A fire has torn through the old royal sty, the Pig Lord's summer palace.

options.text: Leave the ruin as a memorial to the Incendium.

events.title: The Truffle Baron's Loan
events.text: Old Baron Snoutwell of Truffle Downs offers the crown a loan at a friendly rate, for a seat at court.

options.text: Take his sanctum and give him the seat.
The court is not for sale.

events.title: The Lotus Schism
events.text: Two high priests of the Lotus Faith each claim the right to crown the next Pig Lord.

options.text: Back the old priest of Lotus Vale.
Back the young reformer from Mentos.

events.title: The Schism Healed
events.text: After a year of sermons and street fights, the two priests embrace on the steps of the Lotus temple.

events.title: Drills at Unity
events.text: The Unity Guard practises landing from the sea on the beaches of the Southern Isles.

events.title: A Letter from Napoleon
events.text: The ageless king of Skyfall writes to the Pig Lord about the black moon, the barrier, and a strange new tank.

events.title: The Photographer's Pictures
events.text: The photographer we bought back from Skyfall has published his pictures of the sky islands in the Mentos papers.

options.text: Let the people see the sky islands.

events.title: The Great Windfarm
events.text: Engineers propose a windfarm on the hills of Coldsty that would power half of Mentos. The Pig Lord promised: never fossil fuels again.

events.title: Envoys from the Breakaway States
events.text: Sylvania, the Bay of Pigs and the Grain League have sent a joint embassy. They want recognition, not reunion.

events.title: The Heir's Ambition
events.text: The heir to the Pig Throne has been seen drilling a private guard in Piggston.

options.text: Give him a command in the Unity Guard.

events.title: A Signal from the Stars
events.text: The Space Observatory has picked up a repeating signal from beyond the sky islands.

events.title: Out of the Haze
events.text: One of the expeditions sent into the White Haze has come back. They will not speak of what they saw.

events.title: What the Haze Hides
events.text: Under questioning, the expedition leader draws a map: a road through the Haze to a place they call the Center.

events.title: The Governors' Revolt
events.text: The old governor families did not give up their charters quietly. Riots in the provinces.

events.title: Strike on Ore Isle
events.text: The miners of Ore Isle have downed tools. They want a share of the sanctum they dig.

events.title: The Pig Lord's Jubilee
events.text: Twenty-five years since the end of the Incendium. Mentos throws the feast of the century.

events.title: Grain Shortage
events.text: Without the farms of Eurome, Mentos runs short of bread every hard winter.

options.text: Buy grain from the Grain League.

events.title: The Imperial Cartographers
events.text: Cartographers ask for money to remap an Empire changed by the Incendium.

events.title: The Menslosian Renaissance
events.text: A golden age of painting, music and science blooms in Mentos.

events.title: The Empire Whole Again
events.text: For the first time since the Incendium, the banners of every Menslosian province fly over Mentos.

events.title: The Emperor's Birthday
events.text: Napoleon does not age, but he still celebrates his birthday. All of Eden is invited.

options.text: A grand ball at Eden's Crown.

events.title: The Core Flickers
events.text: For an hour the Core dimmed and every island in Skyfall dropped a hand's breadth.

events.title: The Staircase Climbers
events.text: Pilgrims climb the endless stair of Staircase Spire. Some say it leads to the Book of Flight.

events.title: The Book of Flight
events.text: At the top of the stair, a book: the lost manual of angel flight.

events.title: Mask Trials at Equator Isle
events.text: Engineers test breathing masks in the thick air at the foot of the waterfall.

events.title: We Can Breathe Below
events.text: The masks work. Skyfallins can walk the mainland without choking.

events.title: Whispers at the Portal
events.text: Barrier Guards on Portal Isle hear voices from the other side, calling them by name.

options.text: Ignore it. Voices can't hurt anyone.

events.title: The Moonblade
events.text: An assassin of the Black Moon was caught in the halls of Eden's Crown, a black knife in hand.

options.text: Turn him: he will spy for us.

events.title: The Angel Exodus
events.text: Unhappy angels are leaving Skyfall for the free sky of the Black Moon Isles.

events.title: The Cloud Cotton Boom
events.text: Cloud cotton has become the fashion of Mentos. Every weaver wants it.

events.title: The Waterfall Runs Thin
events.text: The Holy Waterfall of Eden has slowed to a trickle. Below, the pilgrims despair.

options.text: Divert the Core's power to the springs.

events.title: The Emperor's Tank
events.text: Napoleon has drawn plans for a steel engine that crawls over any ground. The foundry masters say they can build it.

events.title: Omens of the Black Moon
events.text: Astronomers say the next Black Moon will be darker than the last.

events.title: The Academy of Eden
events.text: Angel scholars want to found an academy in Eden's Crown.

options.text: Learning is for the Core priests.

events.title: An Ambassador to Mentos
events.text: The Pig Lord asks Skyfall to send a permanent ambassador to Mentos, masks and all.

options.text: Our place is in the sky.

events.title: An Island Drifts
events.text: Halo Isle has drifted out of its old place in the sky. The angels who live there are frightened.

options.text: Let it find its own place.

events.title: Napoleon's Memoirs
events.text: The ageless king has begun to write his memoirs. They begin long before the Incendium.

events.title: The Thing in the Cage
events.text: One of the entities was captured alive after the last invasion. It does not eat. It watches.

options.text: Throw it back through the portal.

events.title: The Barrier Reinforced
events.text: Core engineers believe they can strengthen the Doomsday Barrier itself.

options.text: Pour the Core's strength into it.
The Barrier has held so far.

events.title: The Feather Market
events.text: Mainland nobles pay fortunes for angel feathers. Some angels are selling their own.

events.title: The Festival of Light
events.text: To answer the Black Moon cult, the priests of Eden hold a festival of light across every island.

events.title: Fire on the Horizon
events.text: Watchers on the highest island see a red glow over the far sea, like the Incendium a hundred years ago.

events.title: Core Overload
events.text: The Core burns brighter than ever. The priests are not sure that is a good thing.

options.text: Vent the excess into the Waterfall.

events.title: The Census of Eden
events.text: Napoleon orders every angel and human in Skyfall counted.

options.text: The angels refuse to be counted.

events.title: A Bridge of Water
events.text: Engineers propose a lift beside the Holy Waterfall, carrying goods up and down in hours instead of weeks.

options.text: The Waterfall is holy. No machines.
